item.title: Stop juggling 5 terminal tabs to run your dev stack
item.description:
You know the ritual.

Tab one: npm run dev. Tab two: uvicorn app:app --reload. Tab three: the worker. Tab four: the database. Tab five: “wait, which tab was the error in?”

Then something crashes. You click through every tab looking for red text. You find it, fix it, restart it, and then realize the worker needed the database to be up first. So you restart that too.

Every. Single. Morning.
